North Delta houses by price band, September 2026

24 houses sold in September against 209 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 18 sold (75% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 at 26%.

Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: North Delta houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

faq.q: What does the North Delta market look like overall?
faq.a: In September 2026, North Delta recorded 209 detached listings with 24 solds at a $1,100,000 median (39 days on market), and 71 Condos & Townhomes listings with 8 solds at a $622,500 median (48 days) — community-level figures, which is the level this whole-community page covers (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools are in North Delta?
faq.a: SD37 schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file include Annieville, Devon Gardens, Brooke, Gibson, Hellings, Jarvis Traditional, McCloskey, Gray, Chalmers, Richardson, Heath, Sunshine Hills, Cougar Canyon and Pinewood elementaries, and North Delta, Sands, Delview, Burnsview and Seaquam secondaries — catchments are address-based, so confirm the exact address with the district (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in North Delta?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 209 houses listed in North Delta and 24 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in North Delta?
faq.a: The September report gave $1,100,000 for houses in North Delta, against $1,095,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in North Delta?
faq.a: The September report showed 39 days on market for houses in North Delta and a sale-to-list price ratio of 96%, against 27 days the month before.
